# Pour Vida Mobile Bar Services

> Dry-hire mobile bar and bartending service in California's Central Valley (Fresno, Clovis, Visalia, Madera, Merced, Hanford and nearby). The client buys the alcohol; Pour Vida provides bartending, tools, mixers, garnishes, setup and breakdown.

## Events
Weddings, quinceañeras, birthdays, bridal and baby showers, corporate events, private parties. Mocktail and alcohol-free menus available.

## Packages
- The Vida (Bartending Essentials): professional bartending, bar tools, setup and breakdown, basic garnishes, cups, napkins and straws, shopping guide, pre-event consultation.
- The Amor (Signature Experience): everything in The Vida plus up to 2 signature cocktails, standard mixers, fresh garnishes, custom drink menu, personalized signage, drink planning help.
- Para Siempre (The Full Experience): everything in The Amor plus up to 3 signature cocktails, premium mixers, elevated garnishes, personalized bar styling, extended planning consultation.

Pricing is quoted per event based on guest count, hours and location.
